checklist: spec.md § Frontline Surface Minimums (S1 boundary); quickstart VS-14

criteria.notes: 375px is an engineering target used during implementation, not a device-support guarantee (plan.md § Engineering Targets — Non-Binding). Zero horizontal overflow means the worker never scrolls sideways.
criteria.requirement: the core workflow is usable on a narrow mobile viewport suitable for a modern phone

criteria.notes: Each state sets a word, a mark and a colour, in that order. The word is what a screen reader announces and what survives a greyscale screen.
criteria.requirement: verification status is never communicated by colour alone — textual FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE / PASS labels are required

criteria.notes: Measured on the rendered document, not inferred from the markup.
criteria.requirement: interactive controls required for the hero flow carry accessible text labels

criteria.notes: One input serves both paths: capture='environment' opens the rear camera on a phone and is an ordinary file picker everywhere else, so the fallback cannot rot as a separate code path.
criteria.requirement: field evidence submission supports a normal file-upload fallback when direct camera capture is unavailable

criteria.notes: Errors are announced through role=alert, and the copy distinguishes a network that never answered from a server that refused.
criteria.requirement: critical validation and error feedback is readable as text

criteria.notes: Native <a> and <button> elements throughout, so keyboard operability is inherited rather than re-implemented with key handlers.
criteria.requirement: core controls remain keyboard-operable on desktop where applicable

scope_disclaimer: A minimum-interaction check, not a WCAG conformance audit and not a device-support claim. Comprehensive design-system work, a native mobile application and formal accessibility certification are Non-Goals Class A in spec.md.

surface_under_test.access_note: The surface sits behind the same Cloud Run IAM boundary as the API. An unauthenticated request is refused, so this checklist ran as an authenticated operator.
